rules.statement: A person who has been summoned in terms of section 6 of the Act can only establish that he is in possession or occupation of the land upon a valid permit or other written authority of the State granted in accordance with any written law and that such permit or authority is in force and not revoked or otherwise rendered invalid.

rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 6 of the State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act No.7 of 1979 (as amended)
